notes.title: 📢 Update Released! Two New Inventory Slots + More Improvements
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We’ve just pushed a new update based on community feedback. Here’s what’s included:

🧳 +2 Inventory Slots — One of the most requested features!
🐛 Bug Fixes — Squashed several minor issues.
⚙️ Performance Improvements — Smoother gameplay experience.
⚖️ Balance Adjustments — Tweaks to improve overall game flow.

We’re constantly working to make the game better, and your support means everything. Let us know what you think, and stay tuned for more updates!
